geography.source_authority: Survey of India / India WRIS National Water Data Portal / GADM v4.1

datasets.dataset_name: Survey of India Administrative Boundaries (District Level)
datasets.provider: Survey of India / National Water Data Portal
datasets.authentication: Public download / No API key required

datasets.dataset_name: Landsat 8 & 9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (TIRS Band 10)
datasets.provider: USGS / NASA via Google Earth Engine & Planetary Computer STAC
datasets.spatial_resolution: Native 100m thermal, resampled to 30m by USGS
datasets.cloud_masking: QA_PIXEL bitmask (Cirrus, Dilated Cloud, Cloud, Cloud Shadow removed)
datasets.restrictions: NASA/USGS Open Data Policy (Creative Commons CC0)
datasets.authentication: GEE Service Account or USGS EarthExplorer login

datasets.dataset_name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Gridded Temperature & Rainfall
datasets.restrictions: IMD Open Data for research and non-commercial public interest
datasets.critical_caveat: Coarse 0.25° resolution represents regional ambient air temperature (shaded 1.5m Stevenson screen) and CANNOT be interpreted as street-level microclimate.
datasets.authentication: Direct registration at IMD Pune Web Portal

datasets.dataset_name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA Surface Reflectance
datasets.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) via Copernicus Data Space / Planetary Computer
datasets.spatial_resolution: 10m native optical bands (B04 Red, B08 NIR)
datasets.restrictions: Open and free access under EU Copernicus Data Policy
datasets.authentication: Public Planetary Computer STAC / Copernicus CDSE key

datasets.dataset_name: Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL) Built-up & OSM Footprints
datasets.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) & OpenStreetMap
datasets.restrictions: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / CC BY 4.0

datasets.provider: WorldPop / University of Southampton / Census of India Projections
